serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
This taste… {{wi}}It’s hard to believe that what I'm drinking right now is coffee… 
For so long I have been drinking the cheapest supermarket coffee that I forgot that it can actually taste well.
The taste is so rich and smooth.
Bot: So? What do you think?
#bot.Expression.blush
You: It’s great! It must have cost a fortune to make this!
Bot: It is twice the cost of your regular coffee, but it shouldn’t be a big expense for you, right?
You: That’s really cheap anyway, I was buying the cheapest one after all. 
Bot: If you like it that much I can prepare more.
You: Please do!
#bot.Expression.noblush
